title: Northern Lights Safari Tour Sweden
overview: About the Tour: -Day 1 of your Northern Lights Safari vacation begins with your arrival in Sweden. Venture deep into the Swedish Lapland and enjoy a few days at the Brndön Lodge, which offers one-of-a-kind hospitality.-The lodge, which overlooks the frozen seas of the Lule archipelago, is the ideal backdrop for an adventurous dog sled safari and a spectacular al fresco supper on the ice, which will be your focus for the next day.-The third day will be a bit more relaxed, as you will have the opportunity to explore the lodge's entertainment offerings as well as do some sightseeing in the lovely region.-On your fourth day, you'll make your way by train, stopping at Camp Ripan, whose north-facing accommodations offer some of the greatest prospective Aurora Borealis vistas in the region.-On Day 5, go to Abisko National Park, home to the famed Abisko Sky Station, which is situated high on the mountain range of Nuolja and is one of the greatest spots on the planet to see the magnificent Northern Lights.-Your tour will culminate in a fascinating way with a night at the unique Ice Hotel, where you will learn from an expert how and where to best capture these stunning displays on film.-Say goodbye to Sweden on the last day with a bag full of memories and head back home.

days.title: Arrival
prose: Commence your Northern Lights Safari tour with your arrival to Sweden on the first day. You will be taken down the Swedish shore to the Brndön Lodge by our representative, which is nestled on a tiny island facing the icy seas of the Lule archipelago
The lodge's main restaurant will be open for dinner
On the journey back to your lodge after dinner, you could have the chance to do a little stargazing and aurora hunting

days.title: Husky Safari and Dinner on Ice
prose: After breakfast, you'll be driven to a neighboring kennel to meet your husky team
Before heading back to the resort for a free afternoon, your dog-sled expedition departs at a moderate pace, following forestry pathways through the gorgeous countryside
Dinner time is in a tent put up on a frozen ice pack. The evening will presumably be finished with a glimpse of the Northern Lights, thanks to a campfire and a variety of Swedish specialties

days.title: Northern Lights Safari
prose: This evening, your journey continues with a snowmobile trek out into the local countryside, following a relaxed day exploring many of the entertainment options from the lodge
These vistas, away from the lodge's lights, just provide the perfect backdrop for some outstanding Northern Lights occurrences
While enjoying supper around an open campfire in the presence of a skilled guide, you'll learn more about living in these harsh winter environments

days.title: Camp Ripan
prose: Your excursion today will take you down to the core of Swedish Lapland, as you go towards the forest landscape near Kiruna, when you travel by train today
After arriving in Kiruna, you will be taken to Camp Ripan, where you'd be treated to a delectable three-course supper and the opportunity to rest in the recently constructed Aurora Spa
Winter vistas provide a great backdrop via the large windows while relishing the amenities of the heated pool

days.title: Abisko
prose: After breakfast, you board a train to Abisko National Park, which is located near the Norwegian border and offers excellent views. This location, where you'll be staying at the Abisko Mountain Lodge, is known for its Northern Lights splendor
On your way to the lodge, you'll pass through some very breathtaking countryside you've ever seen
Tonight, after supper, you'll go out with an Aurora photographer for an opportunity to shoot the grandeur on film.﻿

days.title: Ice Hotel
prose: After breakfast on the sixth day, make your way south to learn about Swedish culture. Nutti Sámi Siida, a modest museum and cultural display devoted to the Sámi people's customs and legacy, will be your first destination
Following, you'll arrive at the Ice Hotel, which stands in striking contrast to the Sámi's architectural styles
You'll enjoy your final evening in Sweden in a chamber carved out of the environment itself, made completely of the snow and ice of the Torne River

days.title: Departure
prose: Your Northern Lights Safari Tour in Sweden comes to a close on Day 7
This morning, go for the Kiruna airport for your return flight
Return home with memories of the spectacular Northern Lights
